subject.title: fix(channels): enforce native chat protocol fidelity

question: Should these stricter native contracts land only after compatibility and provider-client evidence is recorded, or should the repository intentionally accept the documented break for non-native test clients now?
rationale: The implementation direction follows repository policy, but accepting immediate breakage for existing admin-ingress and configuration consumers is an upgrade-policy choice that tests cannot settle.

options.title: Require compatibility proof
options.body: Confirm all maintained bridges and fixtures use native IDs and secrets, document migration impact in the PR body, and attach authoritative or real-client protocol evidence before merge.

options.title: Accept the strict break
options.body: Merge the provider-native behavior as an intentional compatibility break and have maintainers explicitly own the required downstream fixture and configuration migrations.

recommendation.title: Require compatibility proof
recommendation.body: Confirm all maintained bridges and fixtures use native IDs and secrets, document migration impact in the PR body, and attach authoritative or real-client protocol evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the coordinated cross-provider branch and have adjacent channel-delivery history, making them the best available person to assemble the validation and migration evidence.
